title: AI-DLC memory concept frontmatter (OKF v0.2 profile)
description: OKF v0.2 concept frontmatter plus the AI-DLC memory extensions. The profile is version-independent: it does not name an AI-DLC product version. Unknown keys are allowed and must be preserved. type is the only OKF-required field. CodeKB entries SHOULD carry source_commit, covers, and sources with path and sha256 once stamped.

type.description: OKF concept type. AI-DLC memory uses CodeKB Entry, Handoff, ADR, Spec, Change Proposal, and Change Tasks.

okf_version.description: Permitted on the bundle-root index.md. Concept files normally omit it.

verified.description: One actor event, or a list of them. A human approval uses the human: prefix.

source_commit.description: Full git commit recorded by stamp. The literal unversioned means the workspace had no git repository.

covers.description: Workspace-relative paths, directory prefixes ending in /, or globs this entry is responsible for.

derived_from.description: AI-DLC extension. OKF v0.2 does not define this key; consumers must preserve it.

aggregate.description: When true, the entry itself is stale only if more than aggregate_ratio of its sources diverge or a source is missing.

re_mode.description: Recorded on a handoff. The last approved handoffs drive the delta streak.

by.description: Actor. Human approvals start with human:. Agents use agent:<name>. Processes use process:<name>.

at.description: ISO 8601 datetime with an explicit UTC offset, for example 2026-10-22T17:00:00Z.

resource.description: OKF required. For code, the workspace-relative path using forward slashes.

path.description: AI-DLC extension. Workspace-relative path the checker hashes. Defaults to resource when resource is a relative path.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file contents after newline normalization to LF.
